priorStories.headline: World court finds Myanmar committed Rohingya genocide
priorStories.body:
The International Court of Justice ruled that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya during military operations in northern Rakhine State in 2017. It also found that Myanmar failed to prevent and punish genocide.

The court ordered Myanmar to investigate and prosecute those responsible, facilitate safe and voluntary returns, restore property and provide compensation. The judgment determines Myanmar’s responsibility as a state; it does not convict individuals of crimes.

sources.name: International Court of Justice — press release hosted by UNHCR Refworld
UN Independent Investigative Mechanism for Myanmar

candidates.summary: The Office for National Statistics released October retail figures showing that sales volumes in Great Britain rose 0.7% from September and 2.3% from a year earlier. Volumes increased 0.4% over the three months to October compared with the preceding three months. Supermarkets reported increased purchases of long-life food following the government's Be Ready campaign; clothing sales also strengthened.
candidates.title: Great Britain retail sales rose 0.7% in October, official figures show

candidates.summary: Taiwan's Taiex closed Friday down 6.2% at 36,033.29, bringing its weekly decline to 17.5%. South Korea's Kospi closed down 5.2% at 4,869.96, while Japan's Nikkei 225 fell 5.1% to 56,436.65. Technology and semiconductor shares were among the largest decliners.
candidates.title: Taiwan, South Korea and Japan stock indexes close sharply lower
